description: This file defines the AboutOrganizationModel class, which implements the Normalizable interface and provides a model representing organization info for REST API responses, including properties like company name, product name, version, and employee counts (the latter only for admin users).

classes.name: AboutOrganizationModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing organization information for API responses, implementing the Normalizable interface and using traits for user role management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AboutOrganizationModel with an AboutOrganization object.

methods.name: getAboutOrganization
methods.description: Returns the AboutOrganization object associated with this model.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the organization data into an array, including employee counts only if the user role is Admin.
